name: June
bio: The artist of the four friends staying the night at Hauntly Manor. Sketches ghosts. Ghosts pose.

portrait.subject: a cute artist girl with a messy bun with a pencil in it, paint-smudged overalls, a sketchbook and a tiny friendly ghost peeking over her shoulder
portrait.background: spooky but cosy haunted house hall with candlelight and purple shadows

request: Hey! June here, from Hauntly Manor! Maya, Theo, Dev and I need one more friend. You? 👻
hello: Yay! Theo's already scared. Don't tell him I said that.
I drew a ghost. It drew me back.
about: I'm June, the artist. Maya takes notes, Theo checks his thermometer, Dev makes jokes, and I draw what we find in the manor.
how: Point and click: explore Hauntly Manor, find clues, use items and solve the mystery of the haunted house with four friends.
tips: Click everything. Ghosts hide clues in odd places.
Try combining items in your inventory.
Talk to each friend. They notice different things.
chat: The music box played my favourite song. Creepy AND nice.
Dev told a joke. A ghost laughed. Theo fainted.
Maya's notebook is 40 pages of clues now.
The portraits' eyes follow you. I drew them winking.
nudge: We found a new room! Come see!
idle: {ago}! The ghosts got bored and rearranged the furniture.
Theo's been hiding under a blanket for {ago}.

a: Then who's been eating Dev's snacks? 👻

update: Spooky news: Hauntly Manor updated to v{version}! 👻
